cd /app && cp -n main.db /tmp/main.db.orig && cp -n main.db-wal /tmp/main.db-wal.orig && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import struct, binascii
for name in ['main.db','main.db-wal']:
    b=Path(name).read_bytes()
    print('\n==',name,'len',len(b),'==')
    for off in range(0,min(len(b),256),16):
        c=b[off:off+16]
        print(f'{off:08x}  {c.hex(" "):<47}  {''.join(chr(x) if 32<=x<127 else "." for x in c)}')
w=Path('main.db-wal').read_bytes()
print('\nheader as big u32:', [hex(x) for x in struct.unpack('>8I', w[:32])])
print('header as little u32:', [hex(x) for x in struct.unpack('<8I', w[:32])])
magic=struct.unpack('>I',w[:4])[0]
print('magic big',hex(magic),'little',hex(struct.unpack('<I',w[:4])[0]))
ps=struct.unpack('>I',w[8:12])[0]
print('pagesize candidates', ps, struct.unpack('<I',w[8:12])[0])
if 512<=ps<=65536 and (ps&(ps-1))==0:
    n=(len(w)-32)//(24+ps)
    print('frames approx',n,'remainder',(len(w)-32)%(24+ps))
    for i in range(min(n,8)):
        fh=w[32+i*(24+ps):32+i*(24+ps)+24]
        print('frame',i,'big',[hex(x) for x in struct.unpack('>6I',fh)],'little',[hex(x) for x in struct.unpack('<6I',fh)])
PY
